object: Design Fold Bloom Instrument / LIVE 0.2 gameplay convergence

recovered_user_questions.B: Make custom songs practical: Suno links, self-hosted audio, Spotify/YouTube boundaries.
recovered_user_questions.C: Relate the instrument to Audiosurf, Beat Saber and other rhythm-game forms without cloning them.
recovered_user_questions.D: Compose meaningfully with Aperture, AXIAL and RSVP rather than proliferating disconnected panels.

observed_failure: LIVE 0.1 contained meaningful crease/cascade topology but mostly asked the player to match EMBER/WATER/MOSS at one gate.
Different matching placements could produce different BLOOM/FOLD/SPLIT/RETURN consequences, but those differences were hidden until after release.
On phone the TARGET HUD was hidden, further weakening the objective.
Cross-tab LISTEN→LIVE FIELD PULSE is useful on desktop but cannot be the phone authority path because background tabs may be throttled or suspended.

implemented.core_loop: CALL → inspect target-colored consequence forecasts → choose placement → accumulate RATCHET tension → COMMIT → topology changes future options/music
implemented.forecasts: Every legal target-colored slot exposes B/F/S/R plus cascade depth before commitment; candidates satisfying the current CALL receive a stronger witness.
implemented.call: Each round generates a deterministic achievable CALL for BLOOM/FOLD/SPLIT/RETURN plus minimum cascade depth. CALL success builds a bounded streak and score multiplier; an open/non-call release remains lawful rather than hard-failing.
implemented.mobile: TARGET / CALL / STREAK / BEAT remain visible; secondary telemetry is hidden first.
implemented.custom_song_phone: LIVE can load, decode, play and analyze one local audio file in-page. It reuses LISTEN preview-map, AUDIO MAP and analysis-worker code. PREVIEW is immediate; DEEP refinement follows for <=20 minute material.
implemented.custom_song_timing: Song beat phase/distance may award PERFECT/GOOD flow multipliers and creates a visible beat witness. Timing never blocks release, changes topology, or selects a verb.
implemented.optional_field_pulse: If no same-page song is active, LISTEN may still lend transport through FIELD PULSE. Same-page audio wins on phone.
implemented.demo: WATCH DEMO now searches for a placement that satisfies the current CALL rather than releasing the first symbol match.
implemented.compatibility: Existing LIVE 0.1 local snapshots migrate into LIVE 0.2.

A.answer: FIELD PULSE already connects LISTEN clock/features to LIVE, RSVP and Two Dial. LIVE publishes authored operations back. Same-page custom-song play removes the phone dependency on cross-tab transport. Do not add a central hub; add bounded adapters only when a target app can use a real event/operation.
A.next: After embodied play, export a small beat/event tape from AUDIO MAP + authored LIVE operations for game-tool adapters.

B.answer: Local file is now playable/analyzable inside LIVE and remains the reliable phone path. LISTEN retains Suno URL/UUID + direct remote-audio best-effort resolution. Same-origin self-hosted owned/licensed audio is the clean future remote path. YouTube remains playback/link only; Spotify remains listening/publishing only for this architecture.
B.caution: Do not represent iframe/Spotify playback as raw analyzable audio, and do not add Suno auth/cookie scraping.

C.answer: The reusable unit is AUDIO MAP + authored operation tape, not an Audiosurf clone. Candidate adapters are beat/event tape, Audiosurf 2 local-audio/skin/mod donor experiments, and Beat Saber draft beatmap/event export.
C.gate: Do not build exporters until LIVE 0.2 custom-song play proves that beat timing and topology choices are actually enjoyable and legible.

D.answer: RSVP already has an explicit LISTEN BPM→WPM PULSE adapter; Two Dial has opt-in PULSE LINK. AXIAL/APERTURE should project or inspect the same addressed song/operation objects rather than acquire another music panel. No new coupling was added in this pass because gameplay agency was the bottleneck.
D.law: Projection and clock may be borrowed; transformation authority stays with the receiving instrument.

laws: Forecast before commitment: hidden consequences are not gameplay.
Same-page local audio is the phone authority path; cross-tab pulse is optional coordination.
A missed CALL is an authored alternative, not a failure state; the game rewards intent without collapsing into streak punishment.
RETURN/AUDIO MAP/operation exports are durable evidence; live pulse is ephemeral.

proved: phone-sized LIVE 0.2 runtime boot and controls
recovery catalogue and frozen unrelated surfaces

preserved: Two Dial remains deep composition authority
LISTEN remains the deeper source-addressed audio-map laboratory
no automatic external-song release or topology mutation
next_truth: On phone, LOAD CUSTOM SONG with one real track and confirm PREVIEW then DEEP.
Without looking at explanatory text, distinguish TARGET, CALL, candidate B/F/S/R labels, and choose at least two different outcomes.
Compare muted, synth-only, and custom-song play.
Judge PERFECT/GOOD timing: rewarding rather than arbitrary; topology choice must remain primary.
Run long enough to see whether CALLs create strategy or merely chores. Revise CALL selection before adding more modes if they feel prescriptive.
stop: No Audiosurf/Beat Saber exporter, AXIAL/APERTURE music panel, automatic coupling, or ecology expansion before the direct phone gameplay RETURN.
